PluginData.Author: ColbyJack
PluginData.Tooltip: Play in a SteamVR headset with motion controls.
PluginData.Description:
A native-feeling VR experience for Space Engineers via SteamVR.
- Interactive vanilla and DLC cockpits: grab the joysticks, throttles, steering wheels and buttons - Motion-controlled tools and weapons, with two-handed and left-handed holds - VR building with painting, symmetry, blueprints and voxel tools - 3rd person, spectator, camera, turret and remote-grid views - Wrist HUD and tablet, radial menus, a VR keyboard and all game menus in VR - Interactive LCDs, including Arthur and TouchScreenAPI - Multiplayer - Pulsar Legacy and Interim, with experimental native Linux support
Start SteamVR before launching. On Linux, install your distribution's libgdiplus package. Full feature list, controls and issues: https://github.com/ColbyJack1134/SpaceEngineersVR
